questions.question: After letting Moses see the promised land from a mountaintop, the LORD said Moses would enter it. True or false?
When Moses died at a hundred and twenty years old, what shape was he in?
After Moses died, why was Joshua son of Nun filled with the spirit of wisdom?

answers.text: Moses had laid his hands on him
He had fasted alone on the mountain
An angel had appeared to him at night

questions.question: What set Moses apart from every other prophet who has risen in Israel?

answers.text: The LORD knew him face to face
He never made a single mistake
He saw every promise come true
